functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide configuration modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect those modules to the user interface.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Additional modules allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This clarifies the capability for users to connect custom interfaces, addressing the previous vagueness.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide a notification function that, when activated, informs users about relevant current events, including news and results related to their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Users need notifications about news and results of favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This requirement specifies the types of notifications users can expect, ensuring it's user-relevant.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to complete registration directly at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Registration and login can be completed directly at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This specifies that users have the option to register at startup without being forced to do so.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to complete login directly at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Registration and login can be completed directly at app startup.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This indicates that users can choose to log in directly without being required to do so at startup.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide a live ticker that enables users to follow the live results of their favorite teams in real time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: The capability to follow live results is stated multiple times.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Consolidating this capability simplifies understanding of the live results functionality for the user.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of national and international football leagues and competitions.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Coverage of national and international leagues is stated in the source.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Consolidating similar requirements fosters clarity regarding the scope of coverage.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view detailed team and player information at any time.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Detailed team and player information should be available.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Combining this information-access capability ensures users have easy access to relevant data.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to share news and game reports via social media directly from the app.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Sharing functionality is stated in the source.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: Consolidating this functionality enhances clarity for users on sharing features.

functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about news and results related to their favorite teams.
functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Notification preferences need to be specified.
functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This ensures users can receive timely updates about their interests.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The application shall provide a user interface through which users can directly access available app content and features.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: This describes user capability rather than a quality attribute.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: It specifies user access to app content, clarifying the interface's functionality.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: External server updates shall not alter the application's installed user interface components or module structure.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: Modules and UI are fixed components that remain consistent.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This establishes architectural independence from server changes.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The registration and login process shall be designed for completion directly at app startup with minimal user steps.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reference: The term 'uncomplicated' is subjective and not measurable.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This sets clear expectations for a streamlined user experience.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: Before release, the product shall pass a defined pre-release test process intended to identify and resolve malfunctions.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: This specifies a necessary testing process to ensure product quality.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The organization shall define and execute pre-release support and issue-resolution processes to identify and resolve malfunctions before release.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: It formalizes the procedures needed for quality assurance.

non_functional_reqs.requirement_text: The organization shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to support ongoing product improvement.
non_functional_reqs.requirement_reasoning: It aligns organizational processes with user engagement for product enhancement.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app.
evaluation.issue_identified: Partially inaccurate and incomplete. The source states that additional modules allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface. The requirement omits the interface-connection capability and uses vague wording ('additional modules') without defining the user-visible function clearly.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide configuration modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect those modules to the user interface.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide a notification function that informs users about current events when activated.
evaluation.issue_identified: Too vague. 'Current events' is underspecified compared with the source and later requirements, which indicate notifications about news and results of favorite teams. This requirement should be aligned to user-relevant event types or narrowed to activation behavior.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide a notification function that, when activated, informs users about relevant current events, including news and results related to their favorite teams.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide a user interface that enables users to access app information directly.
evaluation.issue_identified: Misclassified as a non-functional requirement. This describes a product function/user capability rather than a quality attribute. It is also vague ('information').
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide a user interface through which users can directly access available app content and features.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application's user interface and modules shall remain consistent even when external server updates occur.
evaluation.issue_identified: Ambiguous and potentially misleading. The source states that modules and UI are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates, but 'consistent' is not measurable. The intent appears to be architectural independence from external server updates.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: External server updates shall not alter the application's installed user interface components or module structure.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The registration and login process shall be uncomplicated for users.
evaluation.issue_identified: Subjective and not testable. 'Uncomplicated' is not measurable.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The registration and login process shall be designed for completion directly at app startup with minimal user steps.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall undergo thorough testing before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
evaluation.issue_identified: Process-oriented organizational statement rather than a product non-functional requirement. 'Thorough' is also unmeasurable.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: Before release, the product shall pass a defined pre-release test process intended to identify and resolve malfunctions.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The product organization shall provide support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
evaluation.issue_identified: Not a product requirement; this is an organizational/process requirement. Also unclear what 'support processes' means before release.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The organization shall define and execute pre-release support and issue-resolution processes to identify and resolve malfunctions before release.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The product organization shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.
evaluation.issue_identified: Not a product requirement; this is an organizational/process requirement rather than a system non-functional requirement.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The organization shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to support ongoing product improvement.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide user registration at app startup.
evaluation.issue_identified: Potential overstatement. The source says registration and login can be completed directly at app startup, not necessarily only at startup or forced at startup.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to complete registration directly at app startup.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide user login at app startup.
evaluation.issue_identified: Potential overstatement. The source says registration and login can be completed directly at app startup, not necessarily only at startup or forced at startup.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to complete login directly at app startup.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide a live ticker for users to follow the results of their favorite teams live.
evaluation.issue_identified: Duplicative with FR-012 and FR-013. The same capability is restated multiple times with minor wording differences.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide a live ticker that enables users to follow the live results of their favorite teams in real time.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to retrieve live results of their favorite teams in real time.
evaluation.issue_identified: Duplicative with FR-005 and overlaps FR-013. This should be consolidated with the live ticker capability.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to retrieve real-time live results of their favorite teams through the live ticker.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves and displays live data in real time.
evaluation.issue_identified: Overlaps heavily with FR-005, FR-012, FR-014, and FR-015. It is acceptable as a design-level functional requirement, but the set contains redundancy.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall include an integrated live ticker module that retrieves live match data from the external API and displays it in real time via the user interface.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of national football leagues and competitions.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-007 because both derive from the same source and describe a single coverage scope requirement.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of national and international football leagues and competitions.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of international football leagues and competitions.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-006 because both derive from the same source and describe a single coverage scope requirement.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall provide coverage of national and international football leagues and competitions.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view detailed team information at any time.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-009 because both come from the same sentence and describe a combined information-access capability.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view detailed team and player information at any time.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view detailed player information at any time.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-008 because both come from the same sentence and describe a combined information-access capability.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to view detailed team and player information at any time.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to share news via social media directly from the app.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-024 because both originate from the same source statement and represent one sharing feature.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to share news and game reports via social media directly from the app.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to share game reports via social media directly from the app.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-023 because both originate from the same source statement and represent one sharing feature.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to share news and game reports via social media directly from the app.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about news related to their favorite teams.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-022 because both come from the same source and describe one notification preference capability.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about news and results related to their favorite teams.

evaluation.original_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about results related to their favorite teams.
evaluation.issue_identified: Can be consolidated with FR-021 because both come from the same source and describe one notification preference capability.
evaluation.rewritten_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to receive notifications about news and results related to their favorite teams.

evaluation.issue_identified: Missing requirement. The source explicitly states that users can select favorite teams for news and can follow favorite clubs, but there is no explicit requirement that users can set/manage favorite teams as a preference for content personalization. FR-020 covers favorite clubs only, which may not fully capture team preference management used by news and live results features.
evaluation.new_requirement_text: The application shall allow users to select and manage favorite teams for personalized news, live results, and notifications.

evaluation.issue_identified: Missing requirement. The source states that live stream links are available from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport as soon as the live broadcast has begun. While FR-010 covers display after start, there is no explicit requirement that the app integrate supported streaming providers as link sources.
evaluation.new_requirement_text: The application shall integrate live stream links from supported broadcast providers, such as DAZN and Sky Sport.

evaluation.issue_identified: Missing requirement. The source explicitly states that the live ticker module continuously updates current match data. Although FR-014 mentions this, there is no standalone quality/performance requirement for update continuity during live matches.
evaluation.new_requirement_text: The live ticker shall continuously refresh displayed match data while live data is available from the external server.
